statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The diagnosis codes are I47.1, I48.0, and I49.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
